name: Jellyfin
description: Serveur multimédia libre : films, séries, musique, accessible partout. Accélération matérielle possible sur Raspberry Pi.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID={{PUID}}
      - PGID={{PGID}}
      - TZ={{TZ}}
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - {{DATA}}/Media:/data/media

en.description: Free media server: movies, TV shows, music, available everywhere. Hardware acceleration possible on Raspberry Pi.
